body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/18891
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/3165

Candidate parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3107
Independent review parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3161
Candidate commit reproduced: `e866f0bc4107875d64c299bef69e78d94e3507a2`

## What changed

This preserves the candidate implementation and corrects the remaining concrete independent-review counterexample. `_make_checksum_scratch` now creates CPU scratch storage as the live parameter Python subclass before copying its loader metadata. Production-style diffusion loaders can therefore call methods such as `BasevLLMParameter.load_column_parallel_weight` during checksum reconstruction.

A regression test loads a checkpoint through that exact subclass method, verifies a matching comparison, mutates one live value, and verifies a mismatch. The candidate fixes for checkpoint-present buffers, explicit empty selections, mapped/fused parameters, and layerwise-offload visibility remain intact.

## Failing before

At exact candidate commit `e866f0bc4107875d64c299bef69e78d94e3507a2`, the production-style loader successfully loaded `[5.0, 6.0]` into a `BasevLLMParameter`, while `compare_module_weights_with_disk` raised `AttributeError: Parameter object has no attribute load_column_parallel_weight`. Raw output is in `reports/j-6a0f5244de02/raw/failing_before_parameter_subclass.txt`.

## Passing after

```
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-6a0f5244de02/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_disk_server_checksum.py python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_layerwise_offload.py -k "disk_server_checksum or mapped_weights_are_visible_to_checksums or explicit_empty_module_selection"
# 7 passed, 149 deselected
```

On one AMD Instinct MI350X, an independent CPU equality check agreed with the comparison for a GPU-loaded subclass parameter, and both detected a one-value mutation. Evidence is in `reports/j-6a0f5244de02/raw/gpu_parameter_subclass_validation.txt`.

## Limitations

FLUX.2-klein and Qwen-Image weights were unavailable, so model-specific VAE/text-encoder end-to-end and HTTP serving validation remain unverified. Only one GPU was assigned, so multi-rank TP/SP/DTensor behavior was not exercised. The tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot qualify diffusion architecture or semantics. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.

Full machine-readable results are in `reports/j-6a0f5244de02/result.json`.

fix(diffusion): include checkpoint buffers in disk comparison
